title: North Shore Highlight Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is truly a unique experience. As a rideshare driver, I noticed many visitors never leave their hotel or if they do they never leave Waikīkī. This tour encourages visitors to escape Honolulu and experience the north shore like a local. The itinerary has been curated to maximize the local experience even for those who are on a tight schedule. Participants will leave the logistics to the local,allowing them to focus on the aloha spirit 
. This tour is also a tremendous value to visitors without a rental car. The cost of the tour is comparable to what they would pay for a car. Also they will bypass the cliche tourist traps and go directly to the places that Will leave them with lasting memories. 
Finally, as a tour guide. I am focused on guest safety. I’m am a certified medic. With 22 years medical experience in the military. Participants can rest assured they will be safe throughout their time in the north shore.
